newsitem.title: USA: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA rice export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Sales of 23,300 MT were primarily for South Africa (9,100 MT), Honduras (4,000 MT, of which 3,000 MT was rough), Peru (3,000 MT--all rough), Mexico (2,000 MT, of which 1,600 MT was rough), Liberia (1,500 MT), and Canada (1,400 MT).
Exports of 9,900 MT were 71 percent below the prior week, and 59 percent under the 4-week average. The major destinations were Mexico (4,800 MT) and Canada (2,900 MT).
